title: ZuCo 2.0: EEG and Eye-Tracking during Natural Reading and Annotation
description: ZuCo 2.0 is a dataset of simultaneous EEG and eye-tracking recordings collected while adult native English speakers read natural sentences from Wikipedia. It includes both normal reading and task-specific reading with semantic annotation, providing physiological data useful for studying reading comprehension, language processing, and eye-movement-brain correlations.
methods_description: Data were collected using a 128-channel EGI Geodesic EEG system (500 Hz, Cz reference) and an EyeLink 1000 eye tracker (500 Hz, left eye) recorded simultaneously while participants read Wikipedia sentences under two task conditions: normal reading and task-specific reading with semantic relation annotation. Eye-tracking gaze and pupil data are co-located with EEG recordings, and fixations, saccades, and blinks are documented in events files.
